newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Laverton strikes Rawas gold mine deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Laverton strikes Rawas gold mine deal.

text.p: Laverton Gold NL said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with Canada-based Repardre International Corp for the injection of A$5 million to be used for its Rawas gold mine project in Sumatra, Indonesia.

Repadre will pay A$2.5 million to acquire a two percent net smelter royalty from production at Rawas, dropping to one percent after 500,000 ounces of gold equivalent are produced, Laverton said. Repadre also will make available, subject to documentation, A$2.5 million for a convertible note payable in 18 months at two percent annual interest or convertible to ordinary shares at A$0.55 a share, Laverton said.

Rawas should see production of around 58,000 ounces in calendar 1997, rising to an average of 75,000 ounces over an estimated six-year mine life, Jim Williams, chief executive of Laverton, told Reuters.
However, the current estimated reserves of around 415,000 ounces will probably be increased based on recent test drilling, which would extend the mine's life, Williams said.
